highlights: close to local schools and amenities
summary: Situated in the highly sought-after Leas location, this well-presented two-bedroom semi-detached home offers comfortable and modern living within a quiet location. The property features a bright and welcoming lounge, a spacious kitchen/diner, and two well-proportioned bedrooms providing ample space for rest and storage.
description:
LOUNGE A bright and generously sized lounge featuring a charming bay window that floods the room with natural light, creating a warm and welcoming space ideal for relaxing or entertaining.

DINING ROOM The dining room benefits from a built-in cupboard offering practical under-stairs storage, along with access to a convenient downstairs WC.

KITCHEN To the rear of the property sits a well-appointed kitchen overlooking the large garden. It offers a range of wall and base units, plumbing for a washing machine, a gas hob, and a fitted electric oven.

MASTER BEDROOM Situated at the front of the property, the master bedroom provides generous proportions and plenty of space for a range of free-standing furniture.

BEDROOM The second double bedroom is located to the rear of the property and includes a cupboard housing the boiler.

BATHROOM The property benefits from a three-piece bathroom suite, complete with a frosted double-glazed window for privacy and a heated towel warmer for added comfort.

EXTERNAL Externally, the property enjoys a spacious rear garden complete with an outhouse providing useful storage. There is side access leading to a private front forecourt and gate.
